title: Resolution writers append a duplicate resolution when the projection lost a feed-recorded one
outcome: Resolution writers append a duplicate resolution when the projection lost a feed-recorded one
acceptance: satisfy_open_obligations_on, waive_work_obligation and waive_unbound_obligations_on refuse, or are shown not to append, a second resolution for an obligation whose feed-recorded resolution lost its projection row; a test covers each writer

completion.summary: All three obligation resolution writers now validate retained definitions and terminal resolutions before selecting Open obligations. Damaged projections refuse transactionally without a second resolution; committed replay and diagnostic reads are preserved. Actual Test/Build checkpoints, explicit waiver and revision regressions pass. Landed, pushed and installed the validated changeset.
